# EnviroLink

> > EnviroLink provides green building certifications, environmental product declarations, and sustainability consulting services across the GCC region (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman).

EnviroLink specializes in LEED product certifications, EPD (Environmental Product Declarations), HPD (Health Product Declarations), carbon neutrality, zero waste certification, and life cycle assessments for building materials and construction projects. The company serves clients throughout the Middle East with third-party verification services for green building standards including LEED, Estidama, and WELL.

## Key Topics

- LEED Certification
- Environmental Product Declarations (EPD)
- Health Product Declarations (HPD)
- Life Cycle Assessment (LCA)
- Green Building Materials
- Carbon Neutral Certification (PAS 2060)
- Zero Waste Certification (TRUE)
- GCC Region Services (UAE, KSA, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman)
- Estidama & WELL Building Standards
- Indoor Air Quality Certification
- FloorScore Certification
- Sustainability Consulting
- Third-Party Verification
- Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
- Waste Diversion & Management

- [Health Product Declarations HPD LEED Product Certification for Estidama](https://www.envirolink.me/health-product-declarations-hpd): HPD certification for LEED, Estidama & WELL material transparency
- [FloorScore Certification for LEED Projects in Dubai Abu Dhabi Doha Qatar](https://www.envirolink.me/floor-score): FloorScore certification for indoor air quality in LEED projects across GCC
- [Green Squared Tile Certification UAE | Envirolink GCC Services](https://www.envirolink.me/green-squared): Green Squared certification for ceramic tiles & stone in UAE & GCC

## Carbon & Sustainability Certifications

- [Carbon neutral Certification in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, UAE](https://www.envirolink.me/carbon-neutral-certification): Carbon neutral certification via PAS 2060 in UAE & GCC region
- [Zero Waste Certification sustainability performance for solid, nonhazardous](https://www.envirolink.me/zero-waste-certification): TRUE Zero Waste certification for landfill diversion & waste management
- [Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) | EnviroLink](https://www.envirolink.me/carbon-border-adjustment-mechanism): CBAM compliance guide for EU carbon border tax & emissions reporting
